Removed because the measured effect is essentially zero (NCA fold change -0.02 log2), but the ParCa fit turns it into about 87% repression of relA when Lrp is bound. In rich media this lowered relA expression by about 22%, while RNA-seq shows relA unchanged between conditions. Revisit once Lrp and Lrp-Leu are modeled as separate regulators.

Removed because the model has the regulator and direction wrong. With a single Lrp form, Leu-associated Lrp ends up repressing leuLABCD by about 93% when bound (occupancy 0.44 in basal, 0.89 with amino acids). EcoCyc instead lists unmodified Lrp as the regulator, mostly activating leuL and leuA in exponential growth and repressing leuA only in stationary phase in rich medium, with Leu binding converting Lrp to the separate Lrp-Leu form. That evidence comes from lrp knockout RNA-seq and ChIP-seq without a mapped site (Kroner et al. 2019). The measured effect is also small (NCA -0.06/-0.01 log2), Landgraf et al. 1999 found less than 2-fold direct regulation, and the operon is mainly controlled by leucyl-tRNA attenuation, LeuO, Nac and ppGpp. Revisit once Lrp and Lrp-Leu are modeled as separate regulators.
